description: Customers (FDD 7.18): the customer portal. Home with what needs the customer next, My requests with parcel-style tracking, the quote to accept, the rental contract, billing and invoices, and raising a request. Replaces Old EquipRite's customer-portal pages (customer-dashboard, customer-my-requests, customer-request-detail, customer-quote, customer-rental-contract, customer-my-billing, customer-billing-detail, customer-create-req with request-catalog and request-cart) with the same endpoints and request bodies.
